items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Steve Kuhn, Swallow, and Moses. [INTERVIEWEE] Is Hino on that? ... [INTERVIEWER] Mike used to play with Steve Kuhn ... [INTERVIEWEE] Mike Smith?

ctx.x: Same band that we did Home for Swallow for ECM, around the same time.
